diff --git a/scheduler/jobs.py b/scheduler/jobs.py
index 52101f8..f57efc0 100644
--- a/scheduler/jobs.py
+++ b/scheduler/jobs.py
@@ -9,11 +9,18 @@ RUN_INTERVAL = timedelta(minutes=15)
 
 
 def next_run(after: datetime) -> datetime:
-    """Next run strictly after ``after``."""
+    """Next run strictly after ``after``.
+
+    ``after`` must be timezone-aware UTC.
+    """
     return after + RUN_INTERVAL
 
 
 def is_due(job: dict, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
-    """True when ``job``'s next_run has passed at ``now`` (UTC now by default)."""
-    now = now or datetime.utcnow()
+    """True when ``job``'s next_run has passed at ``now`` (UTC now by default).
+
+    The default clock is timezone-aware UTC to avoid comparing
+    offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes.
+    """
+    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
     return job["next_run"] <= now
